imageSearchNotes: This lesson is the course's wrap-up/portfolio-presentation finale — per SCREENSHOTS.md's own exception clause ('lessons that are genuinely non-visual... career advice... don't have real UI to screenshot, and padding them... is worse than having none'), it doesn't walk students through any new SSIS screen. Everything it covers (the finished package's control flow/data flow, the SSIS Catalog, deployment) is UI already screenshotted in full in the lessons that actually teach those screens (Lessons 47-48 for this capstone's own build, Chapter 8 for the Catalog). Rather than re-padding with repeated or unrelated images to hit a floor of 3, this lesson keeps one directly relevant real screenshot (the SSIS Catalog, tied to its own 'take this exact package into production' paragraph) and leaves the rest as steps/outro slides, consistent with how the catalog's other course-finale lessons (Airflow, Data Warehousing, dbt, Git/CI-CD capstone wrap-ups) are built.
